messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today about the mobile app modernisation. To start off, could you share what the high-level goals are for updating the mobile banking app?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, honestly, I just want the app to feel more modern and quicker, like Revolut. It should be easy to use and give me real-time updates when money goes in or out of my account. It’s frustrating not knowing what's happening with my money right away. That’s really my main goal.

That makes sense! So, if I understand correctly, you want the app to be more modern and user-friendly, with real-time updates for transactions. Could you tell me a bit more about what specific features you think would help achieve that?

Sure! I think it would be great to get instant notifications for every transaction, you know? Like when I buy something, I want to see that pop up right away. And if I ever lose my card, I should be able to freeze it instantly in the app, not have to call anyone. 

Also, having a clear view of all my accounts in one place would be super helpful. I like the way Revolut shows everything on the home screen. Just little things like that to make it easier to manage my money.

Got it! So, just to clarify, you’re looking for instant transaction notifications, the ability to freeze your card through the app, and a clear overview of all your accounts on the home screen. Those sound like great features to add. Are there any limitations or restrictions we should keep in mind while adding these features?

I haven't really thought about any limitations. I just want the app to work well and be easy to use. I guess if it can just have those features without too much hassle, that would be great. I just want it to feel as smooth as Revolut, you know?

Sure, that makes sense! So, you want the app to be smooth and user-friendly without any major hassles. Just to confirm, you’re looking for features like instant transaction notifications, card freezing, and a clear account overview, and you want to ensure it works well without too many complications. Can you give me an example of a specific budgeting tool or feature that you think would be useful in the app?

Um, budgeting tools? I guess it would be cool to set some spending limits for different things, like groceries or dining out, and get alerts if I’m getting close to those limits. Something simple that helps me keep track of where my money is going. I just want to make sure I don’t overspend. That’s about it, really.

Okay, so you’re looking for budgeting tools that allow users to set spending limits for categories like groceries and dining out, with alerts if they’re nearing those limits. That sounds really helpful! Just to sum up what we've discussed so far: you want instant transaction notifications, the ability to freeze your card, a clear overview of accounts, and budgeting tools with spending limits and alerts. 

Is there anything else you think would be important to include in the app?

Honestly, I think that covers a lot of what I’d like to see. Maybe just making sure it’s easy to log in, like with my fingerprint or face recognition, would be nice. I just want it to be quick and simple to get into the app. But yeah, that’s about it for me!

Great! So, just to confirm, you also want easy login options like fingerprint or face recognition for quick access to the app. 

To summarize, you’re looking for: 
1. Instant transaction notifications.
2. The ability to freeze your card.
3. A clear overview of accounts.
4. Budgeting tools with spending limits and alerts.
5. Easy login options like fingerprint or face recognition.

Thanks for sharing all of that! It really helps to understand your needs for the app. 

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
